mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.project_id AS projectId, pr.name AS projectName, p.name, p.description, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.status, p.owner, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM test_plan p LEFT JOIN project pr ON p.project_id = pr.id
mapper.select: WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_plan (project_id, name, description, start_date, end_date, status, owner, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT IGNORE INTO test_plan_case (plan_id, case_id, status, executed_at) VALUES (#{planId}, #{caseId}, 'pending', NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pc.plan_id AS planId, pc.case_id AS caseId, c.title AS caseTitle, c.priority, c.preconditions, c.steps, c.expected_result AS expectedResult, pc.status, pc.actual_result AS actualResult, pc.executor, pc.executed_at AS executedAt FROM test_plan_case pc LEFT JOIN test_case c ON pc.case_id = c.id WHERE pc.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY pc.id
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_plan_case WHERE plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY status
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_plan_case WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND case_id = #{caseId}
DELETE FROM test_plan_case WHERE plan_id IN (SELECT id FROM test_plan WHERE project_id = #{projectId})
